author: TeIq
content:
Architect verdict: APPROVE-WITH-FOLLOW-UPS.

Independent verification:
- cargo build --workspace: clean.
- cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings: clean.
- cargo fmt --check: exit 0 (after architect-trailing cargo fmt for one tracing-macro-formatting diff at ingest/firehose.rs:277).
- cargo test -p polaris-backend --no-run --tests: 7 binaries compile (lib, main, db_smoke, oidc_login_flow, session_expiry, sql_injection_auth, firehose_cursor_persistence).
- SQLX_OFFLINE=true cargo build --workspace: clean — .sqlx/ cache grew from 10 to 12 entries (two new query! macros for the firehose_cursor table).
- Forbidden-pattern grep across polaris-backend/src/ingest/: zero Arc<Mutex>, zero unbounded channels, zero unwrap/expect in non-test src, zero anyhow in library API (only doc comment references).
- Reconnect path in worker source verified by code review: firehose.rs:348 Ok(None) arm rebuilds proto_blue::repo::Firehose with the current cursor. Doc comments at lines 12-19, 41, 263-265 document the AC-9 invariant.

Truncation: subagent hit tool_uses=85 mid-decision about tokio-tungstenite version pinning for the reconnect-test fixture. The worker code + cursor persistence test landed cleanly; the reconnect fixture test did not.

Follow-up filed: #51 — Add firehose reconnect test fixture for AC-9 mechanical proof. The reconnect *code* is in place and reviewable; this follow-up adds the fixture-infrastructure test that mechanically proves AC-9 end-to-end.
